<!-- pr-reviewer: 37332ffb0b8d1d45921e3bd4b296ff0fc107fec3 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The checks ran locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `2d98d87be18d0711630e6d824b2ccb0dd90e66a4`.
The source and fixture files were not changed in the review worktree.

What looks good:

- Both new refusal tests pass. They check the saved project, embedded model, refusal text, and absence of an NC program.
- The PR includes its decision record and `Process change: yes`. It does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No existing `.nc` or `.cl` golden changes. The new refusal line names Drill1, 400 mm/min, and the tool limit of 115 mm/min.
- No UI code changes. Before/after screenshots do not apply.

Results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Failed both steps. App: 33 passed, 2 failed, 2 ignored. xtask: 268 passed, 1 failed. |
| Adaptive-pocket tests alone, one test thread | Regeneration passed in 51.793 s. Rebuild failed at 60.000 s. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: example_catalog'` | Passed both reached heavy tests: slots regeneration and rebuild. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Failed on an unchanged upstream lint at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`: `clippy::needless_bool`. |

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test catalog_groove_part_off`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 2 passed, 1 ignored screenshot renderer.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test catalog`: 4 passed, 2 failed. Both catalog checks stop at the stale guide links.
- Importer code and STEP fixtures do not change. The additional STEP suites do not apply.

Safety mutations:

I repeated two reported mutations in copies of the new case under `/tmp`. Each run selected both `catalog_2d_drill_overfeed` tests.

1. Change `115 mm/min` to `120 mm/min` in `refusal.txt`: both tests failed with `refusal lines differ from refusal.txt`. Restore: both passed.
2. Lower the operation feeds from 400 to 115 in the script and project: both tests failed. The errors were `the post was not refused` and `build.camscript ended without an error`. Restore: both passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:377`: Refresh the generated example blocks against current main. The new `Slot Undercut` heading has no catalog block. The trial merge is clean, but the link check fails. This also blocks the new `catalog_check_verifies_refusal_case` test. Run the link check again after the refresh.
2. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:339`: Resolve the adaptive-pocket case budget before merge. Both case tests exceed 60 seconds in quick. Rebuild also exceeds 60 seconds alone. The PR reports this failure and links #3163, but the required quick gate remains red. Reduce the case or place its expensive checks in the heavy lane, with the required coverage intact. Run quick again on the final head.

Failure text:

```text
operations/operations-2d.md: example links missing or stale; run `cargo xtask catalog`
2d/adaptive-pocket rebuilds: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
2d/adaptive-pocket regenerates: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
```

Notes:

The missing guide block came from current main. The timeout was already disclosed in this PR. These are unresolved checks on the trial merge.
The xtask lint also exists unchanged on current main. It is recorded separately from the two requested changes.
No screenshots, PDFs, or review evidence were committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
